        logging.info(f"Processing file: {file_path}")
        
        # Read file based on format
        if file_path.endswith('.csv'):
            df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        elif file_path.endswith('.json'):
            df = pd.read_json(file_path)
        else:
            logging.warning(f"Unsupported file format: {file_path}")
            return
        
        # Data preprocessing
        if analysis_type == "chat":
            # Deduplicate by message and timestamp
            df.drop_duplicates(subset=['message', 'timestamp'], inplace=True)
            # Handle missing values
            df.dropna(subset=['message', 'timestamp'], inplace=True)
            # Standardize time format
            df['timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(df['timestamp'], errors='coerce')
            # Text standardization: remove special chars, lowercase, split words
            df['message'] = df['message'].str.replace(r'[^\w\s]', '', regex=True).str.lower().str.split()
            
        elif analysis_type == "transaction":
            # Deduplicate by transaction ID and timestamp
            df.drop_duplicates(subset=['transaction_id', 'timestamp'], inplace=True)
            # Handle missing values
            df['amount'] = df['amount'].fillna(0)
            df.dropna(subset=['product', 'timestamp'], inplace=True)
            # Standardize time format
            df['timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(df['timestamp'], errors='coerce')
            
        # Process data

            df['keywords'] = df['message'].apply(lambda x: ' '.join(x))
            df['sentiment'] = df['message'].apply(lambda x: analyze_sentiment(x))

        logging.info(f"Completed processing: {file_path}")
        
    except Exception as e:
